instructions: Find your listing on Whitepages yourself and confirm it is yours. Copy its profile URL, then open the official opt-out page and submit that URL. Follow the site's confirmation steps; Whitepages' published instructions describe telephone verification. This removes information from Whitepages services only, not from original sources or other sites.

Find the listing on Spokeo yourself and copy its profile URL. Submit the URL through the official opt-out page. Each listing has a unique URL and must be submitted separately. Spokeo states that removal does not remove information from its original sources and that listings may reappear.
